LESSON: KUSOMA 6.2.1 KUSOMA KWA KINA MAKALA YA KUJICHAGULIA

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: KISWAHILI
Strand: MAADILI Mada Mada Ndogo Matokeo Maalumu Yanayotarajiwa Shughuli za Ujifunzaji Zi
Topic 6.2: Kusoma 6.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Makala ya kujichagulia

SEHEMU 1: KARIBU

Habari! Leo ni somo la kusoma: Kusoma 6.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Makala ya kujichagulia. Soma maelezo, fuata mifano iliyofanyiwa kazi, kisha fanya mazoezi.

SEHEMU 2: MALENGO

Mwisho wa somo hili, utaweza:

1. explain what Kusoma 6.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Makala ya kujichagulia means in simple pupil language
2. give 3 correct examples of Kusoma 6.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Makala ya kujichagulia from Kenya
3. practise Kusoma 6.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Makala ya kujichagulia in clear steps
4. apply Kusoma 6.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Makala ya kujichagulia in one real-life situation this week

SEHEMU 3: SOMO (MAELEZO NA MIFANO)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: KUSOMA 6.2.1 KUSOMA KWA KINA MAKALA YA KUJICHAGULIA
Subject: KISWAHILI · Grade: Grade 5
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Kusoma 6.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Makala ya kujichagulia helps you succeed in KISWAHILI. You will understand it, practise it, and use it nyumbani, shuleni, na sokoni.

KEY FACTS: KUSOMA 6.2.1 KUSOMA KWA KINA MAKALA YA KUJICHAGULIA
Study Kusoma 6.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Makala ya kujichagulia like a learner textbook page: meaning → examples → practice → check.
Replace teacher words with your own words.
If a step is unclear, rewrite it shorter and try again.

PART 1: Explain what Kusoma 6.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Makala ya kujichagulia means in simple pupil language

What this means
In this part you learn to explain what Kusoma 6.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Makala ya kujichagulia means in simple pupil language. You will use ideas from nyumbani, shuleni, na sokoni.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: explain what Kusoma 6.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Makala ya kujichagulia means in simple pupil language.
2. Soma, sema, kisha andika using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Mfano wa kusoma: Soma sentensi fupi kuhusu “Kusoma 6.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Makala ya kujichagulia”, kisha eleza kwa maneno yako.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can explain what Kusoma 6.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Makala ya kujichagulia means in simple pupil language. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 2: Give 3 correct examples of Kusoma 6.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Makala ya kujichagulia from Kenya

What this means
In this part you learn to give 3 correct examples of Kusoma 6.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Makala ya kujichagulia from Kenya. You will use ideas from nyumbani, shuleni, na sokoni.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: give 3 correct examples of Kusoma 6.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Makala ya kujichagulia from Kenya.
2. Soma, sema, kisha andika using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Mfano wa kuzungumza: Zungumza na rafiki kwa dakika 1 kuhusu Kusoma 6.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Makala ya kujichagulia.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can give 3 correct examples of Kusoma 6.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Makala ya kujichagulia from Kenya. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 3: Practise Kusoma 6.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Makala ya kujichagulia in clear steps

What this means
In this part you learn to practise Kusoma 6.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Makala ya kujichagulia in clear steps. You will use ideas from nyumbani, shuleni, na sokoni.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: practise Kusoma 6.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Makala ya kujichagulia in clear steps.
2. Soma, sema, kisha andika using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Mfano wa kuandika: Andika sentensi 3 sahihi kuhusu Kusoma 6.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Makala ya kujichagulia.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can practise Kusoma 6.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Makala ya kujichagulia in clear steps. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 4: Apply Kusoma 6.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Makala ya kujichagulia in one real-life situation this week

What this means
In this part you learn to apply Kusoma 6.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Makala ya kujichagulia in one real-life situation this week. You will use ideas from nyumbani, shuleni, na sokoni.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: apply Kusoma 6.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Makala ya kujichagulia in one real-life situation this week.
2. Soma, sema, kisha andika using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Mfano wa kusoma: Soma sentensi fupi kuhusu “Kusoma 6.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Makala ya kujichagulia”, kisha eleza kwa maneno yako.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can apply Kusoma 6.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Makala ya kujichagulia in one real-life situation this week. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Kusoma 6.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Makala ya kujichagulia is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SEHEMU 4: MIFANO YA HARAKA

Example 1: Soma sentensi fupi kuhusu “Kusoma 6.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Makala ya kujichagulia”, kisha eleza kwa maneno yako. (skill: explain what Kusoma 6.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Makala ya kujichagulia means in simple pupil language)

Example 2: Zungumza na rafiki kwa dakika 1 kuhusu Kusoma 6.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Makala ya kujichagulia. (skill: give 3 correct examples of Kusoma 6.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Makala ya kujichagulia from Kenya)

Example 3: Andika sentensi 3 sahihi kuhusu Kusoma 6.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Makala ya kujichagulia. (skill: practise Kusoma 6.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Makala ya kujichagulia in clear steps)

Example 4: Soma sentensi fupi kuhusu “Kusoma 6.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Makala ya kujichagulia”, kisha eleza kwa maneno yako. (skill: apply Kusoma 6.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Makala ya kujichagulia in one real-life situation this week)

SEHEMU 5: MAZOEZI

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Kusoma 6.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Makala ya kujichagulia to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: explain what Kusoma 6.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Makala ya kujichagulia means in simple pupil language.
3. Practise this skill: give 3 correct examples of Kusoma 6.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Makala ya kujichagulia from Kenya.
4. Practise this skill: practise Kusoma 6.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Makala ya kujichagulia in clear steps.
5. Make one local Kenya example of Kusoma 6.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Makala ya kujichagulia from your county, market, farm, or school.
6. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SEHEMU 6: KAZI YA NYUMBANI

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Kusoma 6.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Makala ya kujichagulia: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 5 learner study Kusoma 6.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Makala ya kujichagulia?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SEHEMU: KUMBUKA

1. Know what Kusoma 6.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Makala ya kujichagulia means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: explain what Kusoma 6.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Makala ya kujichagulia means in simple pupil language.
5. Be able to: give 3 correct examples of Kusoma 6.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Makala ya kujichagulia from Kenya.

Sasa fanya Jaribio la Marekebisho. Angalia Majibu baada tu ya kumaliza.
